piece.headline: Justin takes the week as Ahmad takes the Wooden Spoon
piece.standfirst: Justin's transfers won the week. Cherag's lead over Sid grew. Ahmad collected the Wooden Spoon.
piece.big_picture: Cherag leads, and the gap to Sid grew from 4 to 6. Justin had the best week and jumped into the Gold spots. Ahmad fell from 2nd to 7th and took the Wooden Spoon. The title race has one clear chaser now.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Lavesh left 33 points on the bench. Nobody else made a worse call this week.
piece.one_to_watch: Cherag leads Sid by 6. The Free Hit week is done, so next week shows how his team looks. A big Sid week could close it.

winners.name: Sid
winners.verdict: Climbed to 2nd without any gimmicks. He is the one breathing down Cherag's neck.

losers.name: Ahmad
losers.verdict: Gibbs-White wore the armband and returned 4. The Gold spots slipped away too.

losers.name: Lavesh
losers.verdict: The only Delap captain in the league. The bench then kept 33 points for itself.

losers.name: Dinesh
losers.verdict: Gibbs-White in the armband returned 4. Same mistake as Ahmad.
